lines.text: Abimelech asks his mother's brothers at Shechem to persuade the leaders to follow him, because he is their brother.
Abimelech hires worthless men with silver from the temple of Baal-berith, then murders his seventy brothers in Ophrah.
The leaders of Shechem make Abimelech king, and Jotham climbs the top of Mount Carmel to cry out to them.
In Jotham's parable, the olive tree, fig tree and grapevine refuse to reign, but the thornbush offers shade.
Jotham says fire may consume Abimelech and the leaders, then he escapes to Hebron and lives there fearing Abimelech.
